{{Quote|His palace is a testament to my artistry. I poured my spirit into designing lethal defenses. I also left myself a private entrance inside.|Oggurobb, on Toborro's Palace|<ref name="Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
'''Juvard Illip Oggurobb''', also known briefly as '''Lippi''',<ref name="Expert">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Consulting the Expert|Makeb}}</ref> was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] hailing from within the [[Illip]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]].<ref name="Rise" /> A scientist and an inventor, he was responsible for a number of major advances in the field of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] engineering. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Oggurobb lived sometime before the [[Galactic War|renewed war]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and was a five-time recipient of the [[Bao-Dur Science Prize]]. He accompanied the [[Supreme Mogul]] [[Toborro]] to [[Makeb]] during the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] [[Conquest of Makeb|takeover]] in [[3638 BBY]]. Years later, he would become the Head Scientist of the [[Eternal Alliance]].

==Biography==
===Early life===
Born to the [[Illip]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]], Juvard took on the profession of a droid engineer, considered an odd career choice for a Hutt. Oggurobb soon made several major advances in droid engineering and was a five-time recipient of the [[Bao-Dur Science Prize]]. His achievements were quickly noticed by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel's]] new [[Supreme Mogul]], [[Toborro]], and was hired to aid the Cartel during their [[Conquest of Makeb|invasion]] of the planet [[Makeb]].

===Makeb===
When the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] came to the aid of the people of Makeb against the Hutts and the [[InterStellar Regulators]], Makeb's former defense force, Oggurobb pleaded with Toborro to see reason when the Republic forces captured [[the Ark]] in order to evacuate the people of Makeb when it became clear the planet was in its death throes. Toborro, paranoid and insane, refused, leaving Oggurobb no choice but to offer his services and knowledge to the Republic in exchange for getting off Makeb. He revealed to the Republic the nature of [[isotope-5]], the rare substance discovered during the Hutts' deep-core mining operations, and revealed that the Ark would not fly without the isotope-5 fuel rods that Oggurobb had crafted for it.<ref name="Expert" />

[[File:Oggurobb_Avesta.png|thumb|right|200px|Oggurobb and the [[Avesta family|Avestas]].]]
When the Republic forces prepared to take on Toborro himself, Oggurobb revealed that he had constructed a secret entrance into [[Toborro's Palace]], one not even the Hutt leader himself knew about. With Oggurobb's aid, the Republic team was able to enter Toborro's palace, defeat the mad Hutt and his [[Toborro's Glittering Fury|monstrous droid creation]], and retrieve the fuel rods for the Ark. Oggurobb was onboard the craft, maintaining its power levels, as it blasted off from Makeb's surface.<ref name="ToT">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Taking on Toborro|Makeb}}</ref>

After the conflict, Oggurobb became the official liaison between the Cartel and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], something he found irritating.<ref name="Hutt Cartel Alliance" />

===Eternal Alliance===
Five years later, Oggurobb joined the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] to contribute his scientific expertise in combating the [[Eternal Empire]], as well as recruiting individuals specializing in different sciences. Oggurobb petitioned the [[Alliance Commander]] for permission to run non-lethal tests on [[Hollis-series steward droid|C2-N2]] and [[Seneschal-series factotum droid|2V-R8]] with isotope-5 to create droids to combat [[skytrooper]]s.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref> In the course of his experiments, Oggurobb's team was able to recover the critically damaged and deactivated [[HK-55]]. With a few modifications to the chassis, they were able to reactivate the bodyguard droid. Unfortunately, they were unable to repair his memory core and were forced to replace it. This lead to the droid having no memory of any of his adventures prior to his reactivation within Oggurobb's lab.

Oggurobb was instrumental in designing the Eternal Alliance's [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]]. Its strength was tested after [[Bey'wan Aygo]] of the Alliance's [[Military Operations]] challenged Oggurobb to a bet. If Aygo's strongest [[Battleship/Legends|battleship]] could not break through Odessen's planetary shield, then Aygo would would have to pay Oggurobb a debt. The planetary shield held the assault, thus Oggurobb won the bet.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Odessen: Planetary Shield}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I am an artist, Toborro – but I require the proper time and materials to produce my masterpieces. Respect my process!|Juvard to Toborro|<ref name="Rise of the Hutt Cartel" />}}
Juvard became a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]/scientist, something uncommon for Hutts, a species whose members usually became [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]]. Juvard also appeared to be very self-assured of himself and called himself an artist. However, unlike his employer, [[Toborro]], he has a self-preservation instinct.<ref name="Expert" />

Juvard, like the rest of his species, was large. He also had purple skin, with blue [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] on his chest. He also wore a [[computer interface visor]] over his right eye.

Juvard is fluent in both [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], though all Hutts prefer to speak in the former language. However, when dealing with other sentients, Juvard would switch to Basic to avoid linguistic misunderstandings.

==Equipment==
Like several [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] who had to work with technology in the [[Old Republic era]], [[Kabbura]] and [[Qiltakka]] for example, Juvard wore a [[computer interface visor]] over that hooked onto his right side of his head and covered his right eye.

==Behind the scenes==
Oggurobb was first mentioned in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''. Players who pre-ordered ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', the first digital expansion for the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', received an exclusive holostatue of Oggurobb as one of the rewards for purchasing the expansion before its release on [[April 14]], [[2013]]. The holostatue acts as a Class Trainer for all classes, both Republic and Imperial.

In the ''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'', Oggurobb first identified himself as "Lippi," a bit-of-a play-on with his [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]], [[Illip]]. He is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].
